title: Veremum - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Veremum in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Veremum is a physical-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Physical (C), Vitality (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Veremum
sections.content:
Location: Inside the Monolith - Mistra.

Obtained from Inside the Monolith - Mistra.

sections.title: Is the Veremum Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Physical (C), Vitality (B). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
